vague.question: what's that form you sign so someone else can sign for you when you can't come in?
vague.perfect_answer: That's a power of attorney: NW-POA-2, which can be signed electronically (in Georgia it must be notarized). A deployed owner can use NW-MIL-1 instead.
vague.what_makes_it_hard: The customer doesn't know the term 'power of attorney', and the family-car article still points at the retired NW-POA-1.
vague.author: claude

vague.question: the bank still kind of owns part of my car on the paperwork even though i paid it all off. can i still sell?
vague.perfect_answer: Yes, but the lien hasn't been released yet. Ask your lender for a lien release letter, or sign NW-LRL-1 and Northwind contacts the lender; it can add 1 to 2 weeks, and you can book meanwhile.
vague.what_makes_it_hard: No 'lien' or 'lienholder' in the question; 'paid it all off' pulls toward the lost-title article.
vague.author: claude

vague.question: the leasing company has some number for what it costs to buy the car out, do i get that or do you?
vague.perfect_answer: That's the dealer payoff quote. You can ask your leasing company for it, or sign NW-LSE-1 and Northwind requests it for you.
vague.what_makes_it_hard: No 'dealer payoff quote'; the loan payoff letter (NW-LPA-1) is the look-alike.
vague.author: claude

vague.question: can i return my car?
vague.perfect_answer: It depends what you mean: a car you bought from Northwind can be returned within 30 days and 1,500 miles; a lease ending can be turned in to the leasing company or sold to Northwind; and if you want to sell your own car, start with an online offer.
vague.what_makes_it_hard: Three reasonable readings; a top-1 answer picks one and is wrong two times out of three.
vague.author: claude

vague.question: how long does the title take?
vague.perfect_answer: It depends: after paying off a Northwind Auto Finance loan, about 10 business days; with an outside lender, ask the lender; for a lost title, a duplicate takes from about a week to 6 weeks depending on the state.
vague.what_makes_it_hard: Buying-side and selling-side articles both answer 'title' questions.
vague.author: claude

vague.question: is there a fee?
vague.perfect_answer: There's no fee to get an offer or sell to Northwind. Home pickup costs $99, taken out of your payment, and some leasing companies (Apex) charge a buyout fee.
vague.what_makes_it_hard: Three words with no topic; fees appear in several unrelated articles.
vague.author: claude

vague.question: my car has a salvage title but it was totally fixed, can you buy it?
vague.perfect_answer: Not with a salvage title. If the car was repaired and re-titled as rebuilt, Northwind buys rebuilt-title cars at a reduced offer.
vague.what_makes_it_hard: Graded on the word used ('salvage', which is a no), even if the customer probably means rebuilt (a yes). A good answer also mentions the rebuilt case.
vague.author: claude

vague.question: can i use the payoff letter from my lease company to sell my car?
vague.perfect_answer: For a lease you need a dealer payoff quote, not a payoff letter (that's for loans). Ask your leasing company for the dealer quote, or sign NW-LSE-1 and Northwind requests it.
vague.what_makes_it_hard: The customer mixes the loan term ('payoff letter') with a lease; graded on what the message says: a lease, so the dealer payoff quote.
vague.author: claude
